scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof with standalone symbolic and numerical checks; related general OU and two-temperature methods expressly credited; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Stationary scalar Gaussian paths under passive observation, strictly stable symmetric 2D drift, independent bath noises with positive temperatures. Does not assert response equivalence or laboratory-realizable unbounded power. Possible earlier equivalent linear-Gaussian projection result not excluded.
title: A unique two-bath tuning makes a dissipative Gaussian dimer exactly Ornstein–Uhlenbeck to one observer
